mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We have fair conditions at Badger Prairie County Park with a temperature of 70 degrees. Tonight, look for the ISS passing overhead for 3 minutes starting at 5:49 PM. It will appear low on the horizon, rising over Verona High School in the northwest and tracking toward the Home Depot area near Madison.

The City of Verona has announced that city buildings will be closed on Thursday, November 26, and Friday, November 27, in observance of the Thanksgiving holiday. Please note that refuse and recycling pickup scheduled for Thursday will be delayed until Friday, November 27, and the Verona Recycling Center will be closed both days.

We have a packed schedule of local entertainment. Today, you can catch live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and Paddy Mac's. Looking ahead, Wisconsin Brewing Company features music tomorrow, while Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening November 23.

In our weekly police report, on November 2, officers were dispatched to the 100 block of West End Circle regarding a domestic disturbance that occurred the previous night, resulting in the arrest of a 48-year-old man for battery and disorderly conduct.
Treat yourself to today's flavor of the day, Crazy for Cookie Dough. The store opens today at 10:00 AM and will remain open until 10:30 PM this evening.
